name: Season Identifier
description: Use Jellyfin native Identify on a local season to map it to a different external TV title while preserving local numbering.
overview: Identify non-standard local seasons as another TV title.

versions.changelog: Adds native Jellyfin Identify support for Season items. Selecting a Series in Jellyfin's normal Identify dialog now creates the title mapping automatically and refreshes child episodes through the sequential season flattener.
Initial catalog release. Supports entire-title season mapping and sequential flattening of numbered external seasons while ignoring Season 0 / Specials.

name: File Transformation
description: Adds support for plugins to change jellyfin-web content without actually modifying the files directly but intercepts the requests for the served data.
